limitations: One actor, small shared QA data set, single execution environment and proxy; no multi-region or production load.
First observed requests are not proven cache-cold; no caches were evicted.
Non-feed diagnostic deliberately substitutes one-card hydration and cannot establish full-mix capacity.
Decoded JSON/event bytes omit protocol/TLS/compression and are not billed transfer or network-link capacity.
Connection snapshots are periodic observations, not continuous peak measurements; CPU and IOPS saturation were not measured.
Fanout has zero recipients and does not establish many-recipient or push-provider throughput.
Admin timings are privileged database-only comparisons, not authenticated admin HTTP throughput.
No reconnect storm, multi-actor viral test, long soak, custom quota reservation or approved operating budget was established.

first_observation.note: No cache eviction or server restart. These are first observed and repeated requests; database/cache coldness is unproved.
